summary:
寶僑EPS小幅低於預期2.5%，季度營收逾222億美元規模穩固但獲利略遜預估。
• EPS 1.78美元，略低於預期1.83美元，差距2.55%
• 營收222.1億美元，為本批最高季度營收，規模優勢顯著
• 必需消費屬性仍提供穩定現金流與股息支撑
• 品牌組合廣度分散單一品類風險
ai_view:
訊號中性偏弱：EPS小幅未達標，可能反映成本通膨或匯率逆風，但差距有限，整體仍屬穩健消費龍頭。短期股價或因miss略承壓，防禦屬性提供下檔支撑。中期關鍵在毛利率回升與有機銷量成長。追蹤指標：有機營收價/量拆分、毛利率與費用率、匯率影響、各品類市占與全年指引。

需留意：EPS未達標反映成本或匯率壓力，毛利率須留意；營收年增率未揭露，有機成長動能須結合趨勢判讀；高基期下定價力遞減與私有標籤競爭

summary_en:
P&G narrowly missed EPS by 2.5% with $22.2B revenue; scale is solid but earnings came in slightly light.
• EPS of $1.78 slightly missed the $1.83 estimate by 2.55%
• Revenue of $22.21B, the highest quarterly figure in this batch, shows scale advantage
• Consumer-staples nature still provides stable cash flow and dividend support
• Portfolio breadth diversifies single-category risk

ai_view_en:
Signal is neutral-to-soft: the small EPS miss likely reflects cost inflation or FX headwinds, but the gap is limited and the staples franchise remains solid. Near-term the stock may face mild pressure from the miss, with defensiveness providing downside support. Mid-term the key is gross-margin recovery and organic volume growth. Track: price/volume split in organic growth, gross margin and expense ratios, FX impact, category share and full-year guidance.

Watch：The EPS miss reflects cost or FX pressure; gross margin bears watching; Revenue YoY not disclosed, so organic momentum must be read against the trend; Fading pricing power off a high base and private-label competition
beat_or_miss: 低於預期 / EPS小幅低於預期2.55%（營收年增率未揭露）。
